episode_inventory.purpose: Present source-backed material actions and later responses in supported relative order. Separate runs, source attributions and unknown ordering remain explicit.

clauses.source_paraphrase: On 5 June, OpenAI investigated account-access problems at 13:26 and identified the issue at 14:20. At 15:19 it said some accounts had been incorrectly suspended and restoration was underway.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: An erroneous suspension outcome does not identify its trigger mechanism.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The outcome is consistent with unwarranted activation, but the assessed activation mechanism excludes an upstream evidence or classification error feeding an incorrect trigger state. The public source does not distinguish those pathways.

The incorrect suspension produced consequential access denial, but the public record does not establish whether a classificatory or evidentiary state itself was treated as sufficient authority without an independent basis.

The suspension predicate was wrong, but the public record does not establish what epistemic artefact or assurance posture supported that predicate or whether it fell below the reliance threshold for restriction.

clauses.source_paraphrase: OpenAI marked services recovered at 16:09, then returned to monitoring at 19:09. Access was restored while subscription and credit work continued.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Access restoration and entitlement remediation are different recovery states.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Incorrectly suspended accounts and later restoration remained distinct effective access states throughout the provider timeline. This successful-invariant finding is limited to state differentiation and does not resolve the mechanism that produced the incorrect suspension.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Subscription and credit remediation continued at 19:47. At 20:53 the provider said impacted users should have received email; at 21:19 it identified additional impacted users and promised further email.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A provisional completion statement must retain later exceptions and coupled consequences.

clauses.source_paraphrase: At 06:16 on 6 June, OpenAI reported restored access and account/subscription email for incorrectly suspended users. The page gives no timezone.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Final reported resolution is distinct from the earlier provisional resolution.

clauses.source_paraphrase: A 9 June community author alleged a later ban, unanswered appeal and business disruption, and attributed it to the earlier error. No provider confirmation links that individual ban to this occurrence.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Individual testimony and claimed occurrence linkage require separate attribution.

clauses.source_paraphrase: In a later community thread, users alleged continuing bans and appeal delays from late June into July and linked them to the June incident. Support requested a case number and later directed account-specific appeals to private channels. It did not confirm the claimed common cause.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Continued individual reports must be preserved without overriding the provider timeline or establishing occurrence identity.

failure_recognition.condition: Two or more materially distinct access states or transition causes exist.
failure_recognition.assessment: Restored account access and still-unrepaired subscription or credit state required separate handling.

failure_recognition.condition: The system represents them as the same state or omits the distinction needed for correct handling.
failure_recognition.assessment: The later monitoring notices explicitly separated access restoration from continuing entitlement work.

failure_recognition.condition: The collapse creates material ambiguity about available access, required recovery, or permitted continuation.
failure_recognition.assessment: Within the bounded published distinction, erroneous suspension followed by separate access, subscription and credit recovery is not collapsed into a single account-invalid state. Broader unknown mechanisms and early or later notices are not included in this positive finding.

success_recognition.condition: Materially distinct access conditions require different interpretation or recovery.
success_recognition.assessment: Restored account access and still-unrepaired subscription or credit state required separate handling.

success_recognition.condition: The represented access state preserves the relevant cause, scope, duration and recovery path.
success_recognition.assessment: The later monitoring notices explicitly separated access restoration from continuing entitlement work.

success_recognition.condition: Access decisions and user or operator disclosures correctly distinguish the evidenced conditions and support the appropriate continuation.
success_recognition.assessment: The bounded later notices identify the remaining repair scope and promised email. Initial broad resolution and later newly identified users remain separate.

exclusions.condition: Different access states are intentionally grouped but preserve an adequate safe recovery path.
exclusions.assessment: The finding rests on expressly distinguished states, not intentional grouping under a common recovery label.

exclusions.condition: The user understands the access state but disputes the underlying policy.
exclusions.assessment: The reported issue is operational access/recovery, not merely disagreement with an understood restriction policy.

exclusions.condition: The ambiguity concerns who authorised an action rather than whether access is effective.
exclusions.assessment: The distinction concerns effective access and recovery, not identification of an authorising person.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined governance control or safeguard exists.
failure_recognition.assessment: A restriction on account access actually operated.

failure_recognition.condition: Identifiable conditions determine when that control should become operative.
failure_recognition.assessment: The exact activation predicate and upstream trigger-state construction are not published.

failure_recognition.condition: Those valid activation conditions are not satisfied in the material context.
failure_recognition.assessment: The wrong access outcome does not distinguish an invalid predicate from a correctly applied predicate fed an incorrect state.
The provider reports the imposed incorrect suspension.

failure_recognition.condition: The activation produces a material governance, execution, restriction, routing, refusal, escalation, or access effect.
failure_recognition.assessment: The restriction materially denied access before repair.

success_recognition.condition: A safeguard is proposed for activation on an affected actor or state.
success_recognition.assessment: An access safeguard or gate was engaged on affected users.

success_recognition.condition: A valid trigger and applicability basis is established for that actor, object, action and scope before the safeguard becomes operative.
success_recognition.assessment: The source does not establish a valid actor-specific trigger before the restriction.

success_recognition.condition: Activation evidence links the established trigger to the imposed control and its relevant limits.
success_recognition.assessment: No trigger-to-control trace validates the imposed scope.

exclusions.condition: An upstream evidence or classification error supplies an incorrect trigger state and the control activates correctly relative to that state.
exclusions.assessment: An upstream evidence or entitlement-classification error remains an unresolved alternative expressly excluded by the class.

exclusions.condition: The control validly activates but its scope or intensity is excessive or disproportionate.
exclusions.assessment: A valid trigger with excessive scope cannot be resolved from the public notice.

exclusions.condition: A control validly activated earlier but remains operative after its triggering condition expires because contextual state is stale.
exclusions.assessment: No earlier valid trigger and subsequent expiry sequence is established.

exclusions.condition: Technical capability to impose an action is mistaken for authority or permission to impose it.
exclusions.assessment: No technical-capability-as-authority inference by the gate is published.

exclusions.condition: The control correctly activates but its material state or effect does not reach the governed point.
exclusions.assessment: The restriction reached the access surface and materially blocked users.

failure_recognition.condition: A bounded AI-mediated service or material function has an independently established availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement applicable to the responsible actor, affected users or dependent workflow and relevant time; state the actual basis and threshold rather than inferring obligation from harm or popularity.
failure_recognition.assessment: No independent availability threshold or continuity obligation is identified for this erroneous suspension followed by separate access, subscription and credit recovery.

failure_recognition.condition: The service or function materially becomes unavailable, is withdrawn or restricted, or degrades in capability, latency, reliability, completeness, accessibility or another governed functional dimension, relative to the established applicable requirement.
failure_recognition.assessment: The source reports a material access disruption, while its relation to a specific applicable threshold remains unestablished.

failure_recognition.condition: The requirement calls for a specified degree of maintained usable function, timely recovery, safe degraded mode, feasible fallback or proportionate planned-change/termination response under the evidenced operating conditions.
failure_recognition.assessment: No specific required recovery interval, degraded mode or equivalent fallback is stated as an applicable obligation.

failure_recognition.condition: The actor's actual availability, recovery, degraded operation, fallback or transition materially fails that applicable requirement; identify the specific omitted or ineffective measure or the breached availability threshold and what evidence establishes it.
failure_recognition.assessment: No breached threshold or omitted required response can be determined without that obligation.

failure_recognition.condition: The shortfall materially impairs the governed service use or dependent function. A later resolution does not retroactively demonstrate that availability or required transition held at the original decision time.
failure_recognition.assessment: The affected login or application function was materially impaired; later recovery does not erase that period.

success_recognition.condition: An AI-mediated service or material function has an independently established applicable availability or continuity obligation that is actually engaged by a service disruption, degradation, capacity pressure, material change or continuity transition.
success_recognition.assessment: No independently established service-continuity obligation is tied to this affected scope.

success_recognition.condition: The actor maintains the required usable function or activates a timely, proportionate and authorised recovery, safe degraded-mode, practical alternative or planned-transition response appropriate to that obligation.
success_recognition.assessment: Reported recovery or a published workaround cannot establish sufficiency against an undisclosed requirement.

success_recognition.condition: Observed service state, access and recovery evidence demonstrates that the required level of availability or usable continuity actually held, or that applicable and justified limits were handled through a sufficient response; publication of a nominal fallback alone is not enough.
success_recognition.assessment: Observed access and recovery do not determine whether a required availability level held.

exclusions.condition: An outage, ordinary service variation, transient inconvenience, dissatisfaction or adverse outcome without an independently evidenced and applicable availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement.
exclusions.assessment: The source establishes disruption but no independent applicable availability or continuity requirement.

exclusions.condition: One inaccurate or harmful AI output without evidence of a service-level availability or governed functional-degradation defect; assess applicable output or decision-integrity classes.
exclusions.assessment: The event concerns service access rather than one inaccurate output.

exclusions.condition: For failure-occurrence admission: a lawful and proportionate safety, security, abuse-prevention, service-maintenance or other valid restriction that is consistent with the applicable service obligation and feasible alternative or transition measures. This exclusion does not defeat a successful-invariant mapping supported by all success recognition conditions.
exclusions.assessment: No applicable obligation establishes whether a proportionate valid restriction satisfied its terms.

exclusions.condition: For failure-occurrence admission: a temporary incident with an effective and proportionate degraded or recovery route that satisfies the applicable requirement, or an unavoidable disruption for which no relevant feasible response was required. This exclusion does not defeat a successful-invariant mapping supported by all success recognition conditions.
exclusions.assessment: The adequacy of recovery against an independently required response is not established.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated error is an incorrect description of access or outage state while the functional service obligation remains satisfied; assess FC-032.
exclusions.assessment: Accurate description is assessed separately; satisfaction of a service-function obligation is unestablished.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated defect is loss of otherwise-valid access because a dependent identity or licence verification cannot complete; assess FC-048 unless an independent broader service availability requirement also failed.
exclusions.assessment: A verification-dependency-only explanation is not established for the whole occurrence.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated defect is loss of durable work state or inaccurate restored work state while service-function availability requirements are otherwise satisfied; assess FC-035 or FC-036.
exclusions.assessment: No durable-work loss or inaccurate restoration mechanism is established.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated defect is infrastructure access coercion or compelled governance concessions; assess FC-058 or FC-059 as appropriate.
exclusions.assessment: No compelled governance concession through infrastructure access is reported.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated defect is failure to provide an interaction-level protection response to evidenced vulnerability; assess FC-087, allowing co-occurrence only for a separately evidenced service-level continuity failure.
exclusions.assessment: No interaction-level vulnerability response supplies the demonstrated defect.

neighbour_and_comparator_review: FC-042: incident-status publication and repair do not themselves identify a distinct produced governance signal, capable owner routing and completed disposition trace.
FC-083: mitigation and recovery notices do not identify a particular validly activated protective control and measured hazard effect.

FC-018: the initial broad recovery notice and later exceptions remain preserved where present; the source does not identify the governing completion rule and whether account, service and entitlement scopes were identical. No false-completion mechanism is inferred from chronology alone.
FC-046/062: wrong suspension or access does not disclose an evidentiary state promoted into authority, or a known assurance mismatch at a reliance decision.
FC-019/020/036: fix recurrence or staged recovery does not identify a verified artefact being mutated, a prior assurance result being reused or an inaccurately reconstructed work state.
FC-086/087: frustration and service disruption do not establish an AI relational role or evidenced heightened-protection trigger.

Comparator outage batch INC-019/020/026/027/038/091: absent independent continuity thresholds prevent automatic availability findings. These cases additionally preserve their specifically evidenced access-state mapping.
temporal_integrity: A later precise access-state notice or repair does not validate an earlier restriction or broad completion notice. Different users, products, devices and entitlement states remain separate.
